name: Instant-NGP with Scale-Space Augmentation
aliases: NeRF with Instant-NGP extensions and scale-space augmentation
definition: A modified NeRF training pipeline optimized for fast rendering, compact geometry, and robust reconstruction from short mobile videos, incorporating spatial hashing, distortion loss, specular/diffuse decomposition, and scale-space sampling augmentation.
summary: Instant-NGP with Scale-Space Augmentation adapts Instant-NGP for robust mobile video reconstruction by injecting scale variance into the MLP to enable anti-aliased rendering and compact geometry.
